ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent surge in Medicaid fraud cases, including the Feeding Our Future scheme, and explore the ways in which individuals and organizations are defrauding the government.
questions: How are individuals and organizations defrauding the government through Medicaid?
What steps can be taken to prevent Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption, and to shed light on the ways in which the government can improve its oversight and prevention of Medicaid fraud.
